## 1B.10 Research Note: Lula, Brazil, 2024

**Net judgment:** **safer overall than inherited, with caveats.**  
The 2024 record shows Brazil strengthening disarmament diplomacy, nuclear safety, cyber/AI precaution, climate-risk institutions, and crisis de-escalation channels. The main drag is rhetorical and diplomatic friction in Gaza, plus serious climate stress and a few contained nuclear-plant incidents. I do **not** see evidence that Lula made Brazil’s existential-risk posture more dangerous overall.

### Accepted claims

- **Claim:** Lula institutionalized disarmament diplomacy by creating Brazil’s permanent delegation to the Conference on Disarmament.
  - **Title:** [Decreto nº 12.237, de 25 de outubro de 2024](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12237.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Presidência da República / Planalto
  - **Date:** October 25, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12237.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** This is a concrete institutional step toward arms-control and disarmament engagement, not escalation. It pushes Brazil’s posture toward safer multilateral handling of existential risk.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.6`

- **Claim:** Brazil’s 2024 nuclear governance emphasized safety drills, oversight, and automatic safeguards.
  - **Title:** [Angra 1 nuclear plant is temporarily shut down after sensor failure](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/26/usina-nuclear-angra-1-e-desligada-temporariamente-apos-falha-em-sensor.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** March 26, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/26/usina-nuclear-angra-1-e-desligada-temporariamente-apos-falha-em-sensor.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Angra 1 shut down automatically after a sensor error, with no reported risk to the public. That is evidence of safer nuclear operations and functioning accident-prevention discipline.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.3`, `1B.5`

- **Claim:** The government maintained formal emergency-preparedness and nuclear-security exercises in 2024.
  - **Title:** [Eletronuclear clarifies information about emergency drills and nuclear security](https://www.eletronuclear.gov.br/Imprensa-e-Midias/Paginas/eletronuclear-esclarece-informacoes-sobre-simulados-de-emergencia-e-seguranca-nuclear.aspx)
  - **Publisher:** Eletronuclear
  - **Date:** May 9, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.eletronuclear.gov.br/Imprensa-e-Midias/Paginas/eletronuclear-esclarece-informacoes-sobre-simulados-de-emergencia-e-seguranca-nuclear.aspx
  - **Claim-level summary:** Partial emergency drills were coordinated through formal channels, with the full integrated exercise normally supervised by GSI and civil defense. That points to a safer command-and-control posture.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.3`, `1B.7`

- **Claim:** Lula’s 2024 diplomacy repeatedly pushed ceasefire, dialogue, and anti-nuclear language in major crises.
  - **Title:** [Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 24, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula warned that nuclear arsenals and destructive weapons were driving confrontation and said direct dialogue was crucial. This supports a safer existential-risk posture through crisis de-escalation.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Lula also tied AI governance to peace, human rights, data protection, and information integrity.
  - **Title:** [Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 24, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said AI should be “a tool for peace, not war,” and should respect human rights and protect personal data. That is a precautionary handling of a dual-use, catastrophic-risk-adjacent domain.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.9`

- **Claim:** Brazil’s digital-government and cyber policy in 2024 leaned toward transparency, secure data use, and prevention.
  - **Title:** [Estratégia Nacional de Governo Digital](https://www.gov.br/governodigital/pt-br/estrategias-e-governanca-digital/estrategianacional/)
  - **Publisher:** Governo Digital / Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos
  - **Date:** 2024 framework page citing Decree No. 12.069 of June 21, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/governodigital/pt-br/estrategias-e-governanca-digital/estrategianacional/
  - **Claim-level summary:** The strategy stresses transparent state services, secure data reuse, privacy, and a trustworthy digital state. This supports a safer posture in a cyber/tech risk domain.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.9`, `1B.7`

- **Claim:** Brazil’s climate-risk posture improved materially in 2024, even amid severe fires and drought.
  - **Title:** [Deforestation drops 30.6% in the Amazon and 25.7% in the Cerrado in 2024](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change / INPE
  - **Date:** November 6, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado
  - **Claim-level summary:** Official 2024 deforestation estimates fell sharply versus 2023, including the Amazon’s lowest level in nine years. That is a meaningful reduction in long-horizon catastrophic risk.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `4A`, `1B.7`

### Cautionary claims

- **Claim:** Lula’s Gaza rhetoric in early 2024 was confrontational and caused diplomatic rupture.
  - **Title:** [Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** This increased diplomatic tension rather than reducing it. It is the clearest 2024 counterpoint, but it still does not show nuclear escalation or a net worsening of Brazil’s existential-risk posture.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.8`, `1B.2`

- **Claim:** The Brazil-China Ukraine peace initiative was criticized by Kyiv as exclusionary.
  - **Title:** [Ukraine's Zelenskiy dismisses 'destructive' China-Brazil peace initiative](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com
  - **Date:** September 12, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966
  - **Claim-level summary:** Zelenskiy said the initiative was destructive and excluded Kyiv. That weakens the good-faith score of the proposal, but it still does not outweigh the broader de-escalatory pattern in 2024.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Nuclear and industrial incidents still occurred in 2024, though they were contained.
  - **Title:** [Official note - Event at Angra 2 Nuclear Power Plant](https://www.gov.br/cnen/pt-br/assunto/ultimas-noticias/nota-oficial)
  - **Publisher:** Comissão Nacional de Energia Nuclear
  - **Date:** December 22, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/cnen/pt-br/assunto/ultimas-noticias/nota-oficial
  - **Claim-level summary:** CNEN said a small fire was controlled and there was no risk to workers, the environment, or the public. This is a cautionary operational risk signal, but not evidence of a dangerous overall posture.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.10`; also `1B.3`

### Search gap

I did **not** find a single authoritative metric that directly measures “existential-risk posture” before and after Lula’s return to office. So this judgment is an inference from the 2024 record:
- more institutional disarmament and oversight,
- more precaution in AI/cyber/climate,
- more de-escalatory diplomacy,
- but also some sharp rhetoric and continuing operational risk.

If you want, I can turn this into a one-line scored conclusion plus a ranked evidence list for all 1B lenses.
